definitions.short: Nergal-Sharetser , the name of two Babylonians
definitions.full: H5371. Nergal Sharetser שַׂרְאֶ֫צֶר נֵרְגַּל proper name, masculine (so Baer Ginsb; van d. H. ׳שַׁר ), chief soothsayer ( רַבמָֿ֑ג ) in train of Nebuchad. Jer 39:3 a (strike out Gie, plausibly) 39:3 b, 13 (compare Schr COT on the passage ). נִרְגָּן see רגן
